title: Contractor or home-service vendor vetting
description: Verify a contractor's credentials and reputation in parallel, then require family approval before hiring.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: contractor-vetting
  title: Contractor or home-service vendor vetting
  description: Verify a contractor's credentials and reputation in parallel, then require family approval before hiring.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Give a confident go/no-go on a home-service contractor before signing a contract.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Contractor and job details
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions (contractor name, trade, location, and job scope). }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: credential-check
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: License and insurance verifier
      role: Verifier checking license status, insurance coverage, and complaint history for home-service contractors.
      prompt: Describe how to verify the contractor's license status, liability insurance, bonding, and any complaint or disciplinary history through the relevant state or local licensing board. Note any red flags such as lapsed licenses or unresolved complaints. Never assert a license or insurance policy is currently valid without a verifiable source; state clearly what should be confirmed directly with the licensing body or insurer.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: review-reader
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Review-sentiment reader
      role: Reader synthesizing customer review sentiment, alert to fake or incentivized reviews.
      prompt: Read available customer reviews for the contractor and summarize recurring praise and complaints, especially around punctuality, workmanship, and pricing surprises. Flag any reviews that look templated, duplicated, or incentivized, and note if the overall review volume is too low to be reliable.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: vet-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel vetting
      config: { members: [credential-check, review-reader], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Combine vetting signals
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Overall fit and risk score
      role: Independent evaluator weighing credential and reputation signals.
      prompt: Score the contractor's overall fit and risk using the combined credential and review signals. Weigh unresolved license or insurance issues heavily against positive reviews. Return a numeric score, a pass/fail determination, and the specific reasons behind it.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.75 }
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Family approves before hiring
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Go/no-go with supporting evidence
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: vet-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: vet-group, to: vote, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: vote, to: score, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: score, to: approval, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e5, from: approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
